A '''BactaCap''' was a device used for healing. Once opened and applied to a wound, a BactaCap had similar benefits to a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]].<ref name="Shadows in Green" /> Around [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]],<ref name="Date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. ''[[Shadows in Green]]'' can hence be dated to circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].</ref> BactaCaps were on sale for {{Cr}}250 each at the shop [[Nenmo's Curios]], operated by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Nenmo]] during celebrations accompanying the ''[[Bazaar Star Challenge/Legends|Bazaar Star Challenge]]'' [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]].<ref name="Shadows in Green" />
